title: Cartwise+ Membership Move Credit Share by Late-Payment Record
content:
When a Cartwise+ Membership moves from Cartwise+ Annual to Cartwise+ Monthly on a pause request, the move credit share applied to the value held ahead of today follows the membership's late payments over the last twelve months.

| Retry captures on the membership in the last twelve months | Move credit share |
|---|---|
| none | 1.0 (the whole of the value held ahead) |
| exactly one | 0.75 |
| two or more | no share set under this table |

**Retry capture** means a fee charge of the renewal-retry type on the membership — a declined period fee captured on a later attempt. The last twelve months are counted in whole months ending today; a retry capture dated on the same day of the month twelve months back is not counted.

## Hypothetical illustrations

| Value held ahead of today | Retry captures in the last twelve months | Move credit |
|---|---|---|
| 18.42 | none | 18.42 multiplied by 1.0 is 18.42 |
| 18.40 | one | 18.40 multiplied by 0.75 is 13.80 |
| 18.42 | two | no share set under this table |
